gui.wyspiaexpress.guidebook.select: Select a role or modifier to read its guide.
gui.wyspiaexpress.guidebook.title: Guidebook
Enabled roles that can't appear in this round due to spawn requirements
Watch the clock and disrupt the killers’ schedule.
Your HUD shows the remaining round time. Use your ability to ring the Time Bell to remove one minute from it. Cost: %1$s; cooldown: %2$s.
The Bellringer holds the secrets of time aboard the train. Its passage can disrupt even the most careful plan.
Create false bodies to mislead investigators.
Use your ability to create a fake body with a chosen appearance and cause of death. Cooldown: %1$s.
Body inspections show the role you chose for the fake body.
Body inspections use the copied passenger’s real role; copying yourself reports the base Killer role.
Bodies can deceive. The Bodymaker specializes in leaving investigators deeply perplexed.
Remove bodies and evidence for the killer team.
Use your ability to clear nearby dropped items with your ability. Cost: %1$s; cooldown: %2$s.
Dissolve bodies with Sulfuric Acid to receive %1$s per body.
The Cleaner is an expert sent by the killer organization. For the killers, no body means no evidence.
Locate passengers who eat and use your pan for defense.
You can see passengers that have recently eaten. Use your pan wisely!
The most popular person on the train. After all, who does not want a hot meal on a long journey?
Gather evidence to identify innocent passengers.
Use your ability on a passenger to learn whether their role is innocent. A non-innocent result does not distinguish a killer from a neutral. Cost: %1$s; cooldown: %2$s.
The Detective received an anonymous letter hinting at a murder on this journey. Their presence aboard the train is no coincidence.
Protect passengers with Dream Imprints and become a killer.

Use Dream Imprint on a passenger to give them protection, they will be notifed when a Imprint is used on them. Each consumed Imprint advances your delusion progress. Imprint protection will fade if you die. Be careful who you spend your imprint on, you want to save them for your killer allies!
When an Imprint is consumed, its wearer teleports to your location if they are not in Psycho Mode.
Deluding non-killer passengers via delusion vial also advances conversion progress. Once your delusion progress reaches %1$s–%2$s you will become a killer.
Instinct is enabled for this role.
The Dreamer serves the killer organization, walking between reality and illusion. Reality is merely a dream that can be rewritten.
Poison passengers and profit from the use of poison.
Receive %1$s whenever a passenger is poisoned, even by another player. Delusion vial do not count.
You can see players that are poisoned.
The Drugmaker savours every second of a victim’s suffering. To them, death is just a matter of prescription.
Share intelligence and support the killers remotely.
A game with hacker will equip the killers with phones. Look at a passenger for cumulative of %1$s to uncover their role. Each phone will also show a list of hacked players in it's description
You have a variety of tools and powers at your disposal to assist the killers!
Instinct is enabled for this role.
The Hacker works in the shadows to help the killer team achieve its goal. Staying undercover is part of the job.
Chase your prey and keep your knives ready.
Use your ability to refresh all knife cooldowns with your ability. Cost: %1$s; cooldown: %2$s.
Sprint while actively raising a Hunting Knife to gain extra speed. The Hunting Knife can stay raised longer and becomes ready again as soon as you lower it.
A born chaser, the Hunter enjoys the feeling of pursuing prey. Running away only fuels that desire.
Mark a suspicious passenger for everyone to see.
Use your ability to mark a passenger with glowing for %1$s. Cost: %2$s; cooldown: %3$s.
The Judge boarded the train for a holiday. Their sense of justice makes it difficult to turn a blind eye, though not everyone trusts their verdicts.
Drug passengers and lead them away from help.

Knockout Drug blinds a target, prevents attacks, item use and voice chat, and makes them follow you. Sneak to release them; they also escape if they get more than five blocks away or the effect expires.
Personally killing a target while they are under your control grants an extra %1$s.
The Kidnapper prefers obedient puppets to open confrontation. No one knows where those passengers are taken, and no one wants to know.
Treat poison and investigate the cause of a passenger’s death.
You can see poisoned players. Use your Medical Kit on a poisoned passenger to remove poison. Taking a Pill protects you from one extra attack.
Inspect a body to learn its cause of death. Your sprint stamina lasts 15s
Sworn to heal the wounded and save the dying, the Physician is someone the passengers hope they can trust.
A tireless machine equipped for darkness.
Use your ability to gain night vision for %1$s. Ability cooldown: %2$s.
You have no mood or stamina limit, and are immune to poison and Knockout Drug.
The Robot infiltrated the train for an unknown purpose. Some say it is malfunctioning; others believe it carries a secret mission.
Repair doors, lay traps and restore power.
You have a variety of tools, use them to your advantage!
Wrench can repair doors, shift right clicking with it to restore lights within %1$s blocks outside an active blackout.
You can see all capture devices, both yours and other player's.
The Technician keeps the train running. Repairs rarely seem glamorous until something stops working.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.noellesrol: Identify poisoned trays and prepare protective drinks.
You can see passengers that have recently drunk, or are poisoned. You can detect poisoned food, drink and beds.
Use Defense Vials on food or drink trays to protect the next consumer from one attack. Maximum vials: %1$s. Killers can receive this protection too, so choose carefully.
The Bartender has studied the art of drinks for a long time and has developed a keen eye for a suspicious tray.
Use your Master Key to reach locked rooms.
Your Master Key opens the train’s doors. Keep it safe: another player can pick it up after your death.
Be careful, you got a big bounty on your head. If you fall to a killer, they will receive an extra 100 coin
The Conductor drives the train and knows every room aboard it.
Read the clues left on dead bodies.
Inspect bodies to learn the victim’s role, cause of death and time of death.
The Coroner reads the dead like scrolls. Every body has a story to tell.
Arrange for your assigned target to be executed.

You start with a passenger as your target. If the target dies by a non killer passenger, including yourself, you become a killer and receive %1$s. If your target falls to a killer, you will receive a new target.
Unlike other non-civilian roles, the Executioner can pick up guns on the floor the same way a civilian can. But be careful, if you kill any passenger that isn't your target, you will also fall!
The Executioner boarded the train awaiting one particular passenger’s demise. Sometimes it is better to let someone else do the dirty work.
Appear to killers as one of their cohorts.
Killers see you as an ally. Your fake knife can help sell the disguise, but you are still on the civilian side.
The Mimic is a spy pretending to be a killer alongside a friend who may or may not be a convicted murderer on the run.
Disguise yourself as another living passenger.

Use your ability to copy another living passenger's appearance for %1$s. Your voice stays the same. If the morphed player dies or disconnects, the disguise is ended; afterward, wait %2$s before morphing again.
Every silenced civilian provides %1$s every ten seconds.
The Morphling has mastered the art of imitation. Passengers who cannot speak make especially convincing disguises.
Make sure your death does not go unnoticed.
Your body glows on death, revealing where you fell.
The Noisemaker was devoid of attention as a child. Laugh at this attention seeker, everyone!
Turn invisible and strike from the shadows.
Use your ability to clear glowing effect and turn invisible for %1$s. Ability cooldown: %2$s. Held items remain visible.
Killing directly reveals you. Poison kills do not remove invisibility.
Killing does not remove your invisibility.
The Phantom prefers to break into rooms and wait inside them for an unsuspecting victim.
Set an escape point and return to it.

Use your ability to mark your current position, after %1$s you can activate it again. Activating it again will teleport you back to marked position for %2$s; this clears the mark and starts a %3$s cooldown.
The Recaller used to be a bank robber. Now they have gone good and are trying to lie low, but they still have a knack for escaping dangerous situations.
Exchange the positions of two players.
Use your ability to select two living players and exchange their positions. Cooldown after a completed swap: %1$s.
The Swapper may or may not have smuggled a modified portal gun aboard the train. A little disorientation can go a long way.
Record the roles of passengers passing your traps.
Role Mines report the roles of nearby passengers, but not their names.
The Trapper boarded the train with a few mechanical tricks up their sleeve.
Consume bodies to become a killer.
Use your ability while looking at an uneaten body to eat it. Eating the amount shown on your HUD to become a killer
Eating a body makes an audible cue and briefly slows you. Ability cooldown: %1$s.
Vultures hunger for flesh and bone. Once their hunger is satisfied, another killer will arrive on the train.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.modifiers.noelle: Standing still lets you blend into your surroundings; moving reveals you.
This passenger is somehow part Chameleon. How does Urbanshade keep coming up with this stuff?!
Avoid player collisions and fall slowly.
The Feather has mastered aerodynamics and staying out of everyone’s way.
Read the victim’s role, cause of death and time of death from a body.
The Graverobber learned from the Coroner and twisted those talents to serve murderous ideals.
Identify a passenger’s role to kill them instantly.

Use the role-guessing interface to guess an eligible passenger’s role. A correct guess kills them immediately. The interface requires at least %1$s eligible targets and excludes the Mimic. Server rules can make an incorrect guess fatal.
Killers receive this modifier automatically, up to %1$s Guessers.
A smaller body makes you harder to notice.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.starexpres: Use a burst of instinct to locate nearby passengers.
Use your ability to gain instinct for %1$s. Ability cooldown: %2$s.
Completing a task reduces the ability cooldown by %1$s.
The ability also increases walk speed and sprint speed.
Activating your ability makes a sound that nearby passengers can hear.
Activation releases visible particles that can reveal your role.
You leave a visible sparkle trail while the ability is active.
A peaceful passenger blessed with otherworldly power. Timing that power well may be what gets them home.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.stupid_exp: Take a dead passenger’s role and continue their legacy.
Use your ability on a body to become that passenger’s role. This replaces Amnesiac and can only be done once.
The Amnesiac arrived with the power to carry on someone else’s legacy, even after death.
Douse passengers and burn your way to victory.

Douse passengers with your Jerry Can, then use your Lighter once you meet its ignition threshold: 30% of living passengers, rounded down. It kills every doused passenger regardless of alignment. Igniting below the threshold kills you instead.
The Arsonist smuggled a Jerry Can and a Lighter aboard the train. Their mission is to have fun at everyone else’s expense.
Stay close to passengers to earn your income.
Receive payout every minute for 10 coin per player within 5.5 blocks
The Avaricious is the killers’ extroverted cousin.
Win your rivalry and earn a new role.
Two Initiates begin as rivals. Earn coins, buy a knife and personally kill the other Initiate to become a killer. If they die another way, you will be assigned a fallback role.
The Initiate boarded the train with an unresolved rivalry and a chance to settle it forever.
Steal equipment and be the last one standing.
With an empty hand, right click a player to steal a random eligible item from them. Maximum steal distance: %1$s blocks.
A successful steal has a %1$s cooldown. An unsuccessful steal has a %2$s cooldown.
Instinct helps you locate players and useful dropped equipment. Only eligible items can be stolen; choose targets who may carry the tools you need.
Empty pockets leave the Thief vulnerable. Someone else’s equipment may be the key to their survival.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wathe.vigi: Protect the passengers with your revolver.
Shoot killers carefully. Shooting an innocent will remove your mood and drop the revolver. You cannot pick up revolvers dropped by yourself, but you can pick up ones dropped by other player's again
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Choose a killer role from your own selection.
Use your role ability to open the picker and choose from %1$s options. If you do not choose within %2$s, a role is selected automatically.
Use the Pick filter in this guide to read about your current choices before selecting a role.
The Copycat is gifted by the God of Train and WyspiaExpress. This gift allows them to adapt to any situation.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
The copycat is gifted by the God of Train and WyspiaExpress. This gift allows them to freely adapt to any situation. 

Press E and you can choose a killer role from a selected options
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Convert passengers and lead your cult to victory.

Spend more than %2$s total within %1$s blocks of a passenger to mark them as converted. They keep their current role and alignment until revived as a Cultist. Each completed conversion rewards %3$s. Converted players are not part of the cult yet!
Passive proximity conversion is disabled by the server.
Use your ability on a converted dead passenger to revive them beside you as a Cultist. Revive cooldown: %1$s; they start with %2$s, and are stunned for %3$s. A Cultist cannot be revived again.

The Ritual Dagger immediately changes its victim into a Cultist. Cult members can recognize each other through instinct. Converted passengers and dead bodies can also be seen with instinct. The cult wins when only its members remain alive.

The nightshade's cult is a weird cult praying for the idea that life and dead can be played with
"Their leader says that he can hear his "great behond", is it true ? Is it not ? whatever the case, anyone sacrificed using his dagger will see himself
coming back to life with a new goal in mind, serving the said cult who took pity on them.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
The nightshade's cult is a weird cult praying for the idea that life and dead can be played with
"Their leader says that he can hear his "great behond", is it true ? Is it not ? whatever the case, anyone sacrificed using his dagger will see himself
coming back to life with a new goal in mind, serving the said cult who took pity on them

Can purchase a ritual dagger that forcefully turn another player into Cultist. Cult Leader can slowly convert players around them. Converted players are highlited to cult members and when they die, they can be revived by the Cult Leader into Cultist.

Cultist are considered part of the Cult and thus win with Cult Leader. Cultist have limited shop and stamina, but they do share passive instinct with the Cult Leader. Cultist can also see each other with their passive instinct.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Serve the Nightshade cult and protect its leader.
Win with the cult by outlasting everyone outside it. Instinct identifies fellow cult members; you cannot kill your leader or be revived as a Cultist again.
Your sprint stamina lasts %1$s. Available equipment is shown in your shop.

The nightshade's cult is a weird cult praying for the idea that life and dead can be played with
"Their leader says that he can hear his "great behond", is it true ? Is it not ? whatever the case, anyone sacrificed using his dagger will see himself
coming back to life with a new goal in mind, serving the said cult who took pity on them"
"Luckily for you, you are one of them, be proud to be one with the cult and embrace your new destiny!
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
The nightshade's cult is a weird cult praying for the idea that life and dead can be played with
"Their leader says that he can hear his "great behond", is it true ? Is it not ? whatever the case, anyone sacrificed using his dagger will see himself
coming back to life with a new goal in mind, serving the said cult who took pity on them"
"Luckily for you, you are one of them, be proud to be one with the cult and embrace your new destiny!
guidebook.role.wyspiaexpress:eddie_waffl: The Insane Damned Paranoid Civilian Of Just Waffles
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Be the last Waffle alive and listen to the dead.
Be the last passenger alive to win. Use your ability to toggle hearing the dead. Toggle cooldown: %1$s.
The ability connects you to the dead players’ spectator voice group.
The ability lets you hear nearby spectators.
Kill Waffles. Be the only Waffle remaining. Listen to dead Waffles!
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
Kill Waffles. Be the only Waffle remaining. Listen to dead Waffles!

They are a true neutral that have to eliminate every other passenger on the train. They can listen to dead players by activating their ability, which is a toggle on a 5 second cooldown.
guidebook.role.wyspiaexpress:edge_lord: The Edgelord Delusional Cursed Assassin of Darkness and Coffee Addiction
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: A killer who sees clearly through the darkness.
Has permanent night vision and can activate blackouts for free.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: The Edgelord Delusional Cursed Assassin of Darkness and Coffee Addiction has keen vision even in the deepest shadows ",I was born in the dark", this alongside the Assassin's reduced cost blackout allows them to truly be a master of shadows. Just dont forget a coffee break between lapses of your curse and its darker impulses. Lastly be careful not to cut yourself on your own edge.
guidebook.role.title.wyspiaexpress:gambl: The One Who Never Lost a Bet
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Buy mystery boxes and let chance decide your tools.
A Fun Box has a %1$s chance to give no item, with %2$s compensation. Otherwise, it has a %3$s chance to try the good pool.
Good pool: %1$s.
Other pool: %1$s.
Good-pool items already in your hotbar are skipped. If none remain eligible, the box gives an item from the other pool instead.
They are no stranger to chance. Their mastery of luck leads them to a game of roulette they must survive.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: They're no stranger to chance, but their chance has gone to another level. Their mastery of luck manipulation leads them to a game of roulette that they must survive. They can get a random item from a mystery box.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Reanimate the dead as Fragile Ghouls to fight for your team.
Use your ability on a body within %1$s blocks to revive it into a Ghoul. Revived Ghouls are stunned for %2$s and begin with %3$s.
Ability cooldown: %1$s; initial cooldown: %2$s. Your team starts with %3$s available revives. Killer deaths can restore a revive, up to the starting killer count plus this allowance.
You cannot kill directly, and a dead Ghoul cannot be revived again.
Ghouls fight for the killers, have limited sprint stamina and use the shop shown on their own page.
The Lich has practised the dark arts for years, both in life and in death. They bring back the dead to do their bidding.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
The Lich has been practicing the dark arts for years both in life and in death. They have gained the ability to bring the dead back and manipulate them to do their bidding.\n\nOnce every few minutes, the Lich can interact with a body to bring them back to life as a Fragile Ghoul, a much weaker killer ( you cannot revive a Fragile Ghoul again). 
The Lich themself cannot directly kill any player, so they must rely on their ghouls doing their job.

A Fragile Ghoul is a much weaker version of a Killer, with limited shop and stamina(30 seconds).
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: Fragile Ghoul
Reanimated servant
A fragile killer brought back by the Lich.
Fight for the killers and protect the Lich. You cannot kill your master and cannot be revived as a Ghoul again.
Your sprint stamina lasts %1$s. Available equipment is shown in your shop.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
Legends says that this civilian was once called 'Awesome Binglus'.

You are amazing and makes sure everyone knows that with your notes
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: A killer disguised as a Vigilante, armed with a revolver.
Use your ability to refresh gun cooldowns for %1$s. Ability cooldown: %2$s. Using this ability stuns you for %3$s.
The Outlaw Revolver stays in your hand after shooting an innocent; it has no normal misfire penalty.
People often wonder what law The Outlaw broke to earn such a name. Rumour says he simply thought it sounded cool, much like his friend Michael naming himself “The Maverick”.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
People often wonder what law did The Outlaw break to receive such a name. Rumours says that he just thinks its cool to be called "The Outlaw" so he gave himself that name, just like how his friend Michael named himself "The Maverick".

They spawn and can purchase an Outlaw Revolver, which doesn't drop when shooting an innocent. They could also instantly recharge the Revolver with their ability
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.roles.wyspiaexpr: A licensed killer whose only allegiance is to themself.
Be the last passenger alive to win. You can fire your revolver freely without suffering any penalty.
You have instinct and your sprint stamina lasts %1$s.
The Licensed Villain carries an officially certified villain licence. After all, he is a professional.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
The Licensed Villain is a rare character holding an officially certified villain license. He only appears when there are enough players

The Licensed Villain's win condition is unique - he must kill everyone. When all civilians or all killers are eliminated, the game does not end. Only he can end it all with his own hands.

The Licensed Villain has 15 seconds of sprint time, boards with Lockpick, and receives coins for completing tasks.

Revolver can be purchased at the shop, and he suffers no misfire penalty when using it - after all, he's a professional.
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.modifiers.wyspia: A rare civilian supplied with explosives.
When enabled, a random civilian has a 1 in %1$s chance of receiving this modifier. Starting explosives are shown below.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: I have some funny bombs, wanna test it?
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.modifiers.wyspia: Your player outline is hidden from instinct when the observer is between %1$s and %2$s blocks away. Outside that range, ordinary instinct rules apply.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
Master of hide and seek. 

Player with elusive will be hidden from most active instinct. But passive instinct like Starstruck will still see you
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.modifiers.wyspia: Carry an Employee Key for certain doors.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress: You get no benefit other than a key called "Employee Key". This key can open some doors
guidebook.wyspiaexpress.modifiers.wyspia: Move faster while crawling through the train.
Crawling speed multiplier: %1$s, applied alongside the general crawl multiplier.
Many hours in cramped passages have taught this passenger how to move through them.
guidebook.role.description.wyspiaexpress:
Why are you venting? 
GUYS RED IS SUS !!!

Gain 50% increased speed when crawling
